text:
Rae T.: Hi all — returning from parental leave next month but will be traveling for 2 weeks for family care. Quick Qs: 1) Can I keep my lactation room reservation priority while traveling/remote? 2) Is travel reimbursable if I need to pump on the road (like hotel with kitchenette)? 3) How does PTO interplay if I need extra days beyond leave?

Sofia (People Ops): Short answers: lactation room priority is tied to active employment and on-site days; if you're remote while traveling we can't reserve a campus room but can help book hotel or partner spaces. Travel reimbursement: potentially yes if travel is company-approved and pumping-related incidental expenses are documented. PTO: extra days beyond paid parental leave are charged to PTO or unpaid leave per your request.

Rae T.: For reimbursements, what docs do I need? Receipts? A manager approval?

Finance-Bot: Reimbursement policy: submit expense with receipts and brief note ("pumping-related lodging/meals during approved travel"); attach manager approval email. Use expense code MED-TRVL. If you need an advance, request via the travel portal.

Maya (Manager): Rae — I can approve the travel if you send travel dates and estimate. For the first two weeks back we can stagger onsite days so you have flexible access. I'll keep your lactation room time slot open when you're on campus.

Office-Admin: If you're on campus any day, DM me the dates and I'll block the lactation room under your name. For partner hotel spaces, we have a vendor list — ping me and I'll share.

Rae T.: Great — I'll send travel dates and receipts. One last: if I add 5 PTO days after leave, does that change benefits eligibility or childcare stipend?

Sofia (People Ops): Adding PTO immediately after paid leave doesn't change eligibility for benefits that are tied to active employment. Childcare stipend only applies during approved active leave; PTO is treated as time worked for most benefits but stipend won't continue on PTO. If you want the stipend extended, file an amendment and we'll review.

Rae T.: Perfect. Sending dates now. Thanks everyone :pray:
_notes: Thread about lactation room access while traveling, travel reimbursement for pumping-related expenses, PTO interaction with stipend, and coordination for manager approvals and office admin.
